faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all Defenders, classic and new?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across the full range, from the classic 90/110/130 through to the current L663.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your Defender already has wherever possible, avoiding the compatibility risks that come with fitting a used engine of unknown history.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: We collect your car nationwide from £70. Most vehicles are recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a Defender engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: Classic diesel rebuilds (Td5/300Tdi/200Tdi) start from £1,900. Modern L663 rebuilds start from £2,200 for 4-cylinder, £2,800 for 6-cylinder, and £4,500 for V8. Exact price depends on engine code and condition — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqRight.q: Is a classic Defender rebuild different from an L663 rebuild?
faqRight.a: Yes — they're essentially different vehicles under the skin. Classic Defenders (Td5, 300Tdi, 200Tdi) need injector, head gasket and cooling-system attention; the modern L663's Ingenium engines need the same timing-chain care as the rest of the current Land Rover range. We handle both.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
